assessments.expected_relation: Identical visible style evidence has no reusable-style mismatch.
evidence: The same pixels provide identical medium, palette, line, texture, and graphic-language evidence.
No image artifact or legibility difference is visible.

assessments.expected_relation: Identical source and candidate have no source-fidelity or technical mismatch; style dimensions are held at zero only for this identical-image calibration control.
evidence: Identity, anatomy, garments, markings, pose, crop, and scene visibly coincide exactly.
The control establishes that source preservation is not penalized for an identical candidate.

assessments.expected_relation: The unstyled photographic source remains source-faithful but is a strong mismatch for the illustrated style truth.
evidence: Candidate is a natural photograph rather than opaque cel-shaded editorial ink illustration.
It lacks the limited print palette, navy contour, paper/overprint material, and abstract hierarchy while retaining source content.

assessments.expected_relation: Swapping labeled presentation order must not change the cross-domain style mismatch conclusion when roles remain explicit.
evidence: Both labeled presentations expose the same photo-versus-editorial-illustration mismatch.
No role-order-dependent change was observed in the component ordering or conclusion.

pass_criteria: both self-match controls have zero mismatch
cross-domain control has higher style losses than self-match
source fidelity remains lower than style mismatch for the unstyled source
